blurb: Guests soak in a private wood-fired hot tub boat set to their preferred temperature while cruising calm, protected water with views of the Boston skyline and planes overhead. The boat is easy to drive with no experience needed and accommodates up to six guests. The tub is drained, cleaned, and refilled with fresh water between each session.
